latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Hashtag Generator — initial release.

- Generate AI-powered hashtags for videos to boost reach on platforms like TikTok and Instagram.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and get tagged video files in under 20 seconds.
- Automatic setup connects to the cloud backend and manages session tokens without exposing sensitive data.
- Supports video edits, track previews, and fast export/download of processed clips.
- Includes workflows for batch processing, iterative editing, and quick hashtag generation.
